chunks: And with his chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
To Ali, Fatima, Al-Hasan, Al-Husayn (peace be upon them), Al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib, and Aqil: I am war to whoever wars against you, and peace to whoever makes peace with you.
The author of this book (may God have mercy on him) said: The mention of Aqil and Al-Abbas is rare in this hadith; I have not heard it except from Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi in this hadith.

key_terms.غَرِيبٌ: Rare/Strange (in hadith sciences, referring to a narration with a unique chain or content)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Prophet's declaration of war and peace regarding his family members in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This Hadith establishes the principle of 'Hubb' (affection) and 'Sabr' (patience) as the basis for political and spiritual allegiance, extending the Prophet's personal stance to the broader Ahl al-Bayt including Abbas and Aqil. The inclusion of Abbas and Aqil, noted as rare by Shaykh al-Saduq, highlights the comprehensive nature of the Prophet's bond with his entire household, reinforcing their status as the primary reference for the community after him. This narration serves as a foundational text for the Shia concept of Walayah, linking love for the Imams directly to the Prophet's own identity.
